Arthroscopic Surgery in Hyderabad

Arthroscopic surgery, also known as keyhole or minimally invasive surgery, is a modern orthopedic procedure used to diagnose and treat joint problems with minimal disruption to the surrounding tissues. Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy utilizes advanced arthroscopy techniques at Apollo Hospitals, Hyderabad, providing patients with a quicker recovery and less post-operative pain compared to traditional open surgery.

Learn more

Hip Replacement Surgery in Hyderabad

Hip replacement surgery, also known as hip arthroplasty, is a procedure where a damaged or diseased hip joint is replaced with an artificial implant to relieve pain and restore function. Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy offers expert hip replacement surgery at Apollo Hospitals, Financial District, Hyderabad, ensuring patients receive top-notch care with advanced techniques.
